title: Threaded comments with vote counts
description: Reddit-style threaded comments. Each comment is an AP Note with inReplyTo. Vote counts (upvotes - downvotes) determine sort order. Score-based sorting (hot, top, new, controversial). Different from Mastodon's flat reply model.
close_reason: Community mode complete. communities_db (28 functions, 33 tests, hot sort), AP Group actors, Lemmy API v3 (12 endpoints) in all 3 servers.
